1. Preamble Present day students are much different from the students of the past in many ways. Today, they like to make decisions on their own and plan their future by themselves. However, student aspirations on one hand and the demands of the work place on the other have become highly diverse. Employers expect students to have multi-disciplinary competency, leadership skills, and be ICT (Information and Communication Technology) ready. The rigid, cohort system of learning, offers little flexibility to students in selecting the courses of their choice and helps little in becoming a well-rounded personality. As part of continuous improvement in providing quality education, during 2008, VIT has taken the right step in this direction by introducing the Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS™) into its academic curriculum. Through this, the students can register for courses of their choice altering at will, the pace of learning within the broad framework of an academic course and credit requirements, as time progresses. answer_extract: A course credit is a measurement of duration that the course is offered as an ‘instruction’ to students. All courses are considered to be offered for the entire duration of a semester. A semester is deemed to have 15 instructional (non -exam) weeks. A class room lecture (L) of 50 minutes duration per week, carried out during all weeks of the semester, shall be considered as one Instructional Unit or one Credit. A tutorial (T) of 50 minutes duration per week, carried out during all weeks of the semester, shall be considered as one Instructional Unit or one Credit. question: What does Hostels | VIT say about Hostels?

A home away from home, the hostels at VIT is more than four walls and a roof. They have been designed to provide a comfortable, safe, inclusive and secure living even as they provide opportunities to form lasting friendships and ease the transition from home to college. Residential staff is always available to support the students from different backgrounds to promote community. Living on campus provides students with opportunities to:
* Connect with a diverse population of people * Develop stronger interpersonal and communication skills * Engage in campus leadership, organizations and activities * Establish relationship with faculty and staff members
Hostel review committee meetings are conducted once in 15 days by the hostel administrators to address students’ queries, requirements and to keep them updated on upgradation of services and events. Students are also given the privilege to give suggestions to improve the hostel facilities.

question: What does Counselling Division say about CENTRE FOR VIT HAPPINESS AND WELL BEING?
answer_extract:
Welcome to our Centre, which is dedicated to the idea that all of us can learn to live happier, more fulfilling lives. We believe happiness is a skill and skills can be taught, practised, and shared.
True education at VIT is a journey of growth, balance, and self-discovery, built on the principle that happiness is a skill to be taught, practised, and shared. By treating happiness as a teachable skill, we empower our institution to learn, practice, and share lifelong well-being. Recognising that our students, faculty, and staff are dynamic individuals with unique emotional and mental health needs, we ensure well-being is never an afterthought, but a core part of the university experience.
Academics and personal growth can feel overwhelming, which is why our counselling services are deeply embedded in our institutional ethos. Built on the principles of holistic development, this robust framework provides a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment.
We empower the VIT family to conquer challenges, cultivate lifelong resilience, and achieve holistic emotional, social, and personal growth.

question: What does Counselling Division say about Tele MANAS (Tele Mental Health Assistance and Networking Across States)?
answer_extract:
**Tele Manas** is a **National Mental Health helpline** initiative by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MOHFW), Government of India. It is the digital component of the **National Mental Health Programme (NMHP).**
* Tele MANAS aims to provide free tele-mental health services all over the country, round the clock. * A toll-free, 24×7 helpline number 14416 has been set up across the country, allowing callers to select the language of their choice for availing services. * Service is also accessible with 1-800-91-4416. The calls would be routed to Tele MANAS cells in the respective state and Union Territory. * To make mental health services more accessible, the Tele MANAS citizen app is now available on the Google Play Store.

It is Sri Sakthi Amma’s divine vision which inspired the establishment of Sri Narayani Hospital & Research Centre. Sri Narayani Hospital Department for Internal Medicine, Infectious Diseases & Lifestyle Disorders Internal medicine specialists or internists deal with a wide range of health conditions that affect adults. Internal medicine specialty is not confined to a specific health issue or problems of an organ system – the specialty deals with a comprehensive spectrum of diseases.
A physician who specializes in internal medicine is known as an internist. He deals with the diagnosis of common, rare, simple and complex health conditions. VIT ensures to meet all its duties to provide a safe place of work and a healthy working environment for the students, faculties, staffs and members of public, who visits the University. We believe that health and safety is the highest priority of our strategic plan.
Fire is the major threat to life and infrastructure, an outbreak of even a blaze (minor fire), possess significant risks to the continuing research and teaching functions undertaken within the university.
In compliance with the guidelines of National Building Code 2016 Part IV ((fire and life safety system), VIT is committed to strictly adhere and upgrade all the duties, specified in the regulations. question: What does VIT Campus Amenities | Vellore Institute of Technology | VIT say about Innovative Cooling System?
answer_extract:
VIT has successfully scaled up an innovative cooling system, capable of providing 24hrs radiative cooling for the structures. The combined mode of passive cooling increases the energy efficiency, environment friendly and thermal comfort for the occupants in accordance with India cooling action plan (ICAP), which is being installed at 75,000 sq. ft airconditioned area located at Gandhi block.
Radiant cooling with indirect evaporative cooling system satisfies the cooling requirements of the studio type classrooms and the corridors and for the seminar halls and laboratories, radiant cooling with centralised chiller system is been installed to meet the cooling requirements. Comparing the same with other active cooling system, the innovative cooling system takes the advantage for the reduction of CO2 emission, energy savings, peak demand reductions, minimal payback period, reduce the potential airborne transmission of the virus.

question: What does FAQs - SHINE - Vellore Institute of Technology say about School of Healthcare Science and Engineering (SHINE)?
answer_extract:
1. What makes this course unique compared to other contemporary courses?
This course stands out due to its unique interdisciplinary approach, effectively merging engineering, science, and medicine. It equips students with a comprehensive understanding of both healthcare principles and advanced technological tools, specifically preparing them for innovative roles in the rapidly evolving field of healthcare technology.
2. Why should I consider joining this course?
You should consider joining this course if you are interested in the dynamic intersection of healthcare and technology. It provides a deep understanding of how technology is fundamentally reshaping the future of healthcare, making it an excellent choice for those passionate about both the fields.
3. How is Health Sciences and Technology different from Biomedical Engineering and Biotechnology?
Health Sciences and Technology distinguishes itself by broadly integrating engineering principles directly with healthcare applications, with a significant focus on areas like AI and medical technology. This provides a wider scope compared to Biomedical Engineering, which typically concentrates more narrowly on medical devices, and Biotechnology, which primarily deals with biological systems.
title: FAQs - SHINE - Vellore Institute of Technology

Core subjects provide a strong base in the interdisciplinary nature of the field. Yes, the course is designed to be accessible to students regardless of their prior background in biology or mathematics. The curriculum is structured to introduce basic concepts progressively, allowing students to build their knowledge gradually and successfully.

Ragging constitutes one or more of any of the following acts:

Asking any student to do any act which such student will not in the ordinary course do and which has the effect of causing or generating a sense of shame, or torment or embarrassment so as to adversely affect the physique or psyche of such fresher or any other student. 4. ### How many sessions does VITREE run per year?
VITREE is conducted for two sessions per year: July and January. This page covers the July 2026 session. January 2026 session results have already been declared.
### What is the difference between Ph.D. and Direct Ph.D. at VIT?
The Ph.D. requires a postgraduate (Master’s) degree for entry. The Direct Ph.D. allows B.E./B.Tech. graduates with First Class to bypass a separate Master’s degree and proceed directly to doctoral research, on a full-time basis only.
### What is the Ph.D. in Deep Technology at VIT?
The Ph.D. in Deep Technology is a Chancellor Fellowship doctoral programme for research in nationally strategic deep-tech domains. It requires a separate application template and is only available as Internal Full Time.
### What is the VITREE exam pattern?
VITREE is a 2-hour Computer-Based Test with 100 MCQs. For Ph.D.: 70 Technical, 15 English Communication, 15 Statistics and Probability. For Direct Ph.D.: 80 Technical and 20 English Communication.

A B.E. or B.Tech. degree with First Class from a recognised university. Candidates do not need a Master’s degree but must apply for Internal Full Time only.

Yes. All candidates must submit a two-page research proposal at the time of application, using the prescribed template: one template for Ph.D. and Direct Ph.D., and a separate template for the Deep Technology Chancellor Fellowship programme.

Selection combines the VITREE CBT score, marks in the qualifying degree (PG for Ph.D., UG for Direct Ph.D.), the research proposal, and performance in the Personal Interview.

No. Change of test venue, campus, date of interview or programme is not permitted after submission.

question: What does International Projects-(SAP) - Vellore Institute of Technology say about INTERNATIONAL PROJECTS?
answer_extract:
**Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore has been selected for a prestigious Erasmus Plus European Union Project for its strategic management of internationalisation in higher education**
Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), Vellore has been selected for a prestigious Erasmus Plus European Union Project for its internationalization strategy, This project has been funded with support from the European Commission,led by the University of Zaragoza, Spain and the European Policy Development and Research Institute, Slovenia, “The HARMONY project aims to support the modernisation, accessibility, and internationalisation of the higher education institutions in India, Bangladesh and Vietnam and to contribute to the cooperation between the European universities and Asian universities.
The HARMONY project aims to have an impact and trigger reform processes at institutional level in Asian Universities. Top managers of Higher Education Institutions will receive support for evidence-based strategy development and better regulation to move towards the modernisation of the framework conditions for Higher Education in their respective countries.
title: International Projects-(SAP) - Vellore Institute of Technology
heading: INTERNATIONAL PROJECTS

question: What does International Projects-(SAP) - Vellore Institute of Technology say about INTERNATIONAL PROJECTS?
answer_extract:
The project called, “Internationalization and Virtual Exchange: Borderless between EU and Asian Countries,” involves institutions in Bulgaria, Lithuania, Bangladesh, Vietnam, and India. From India, besides VIT the University of Hyderabad and the Narsee Monjee Institute of Management Studies will also participate.VIT has received grant amount Rs.68 lakhs for the three-year tenure. The project coordinated by Dr.R.Seenivasan, Professor, CNBT and Deputy Director, International Relations Office , VIT.
The HARMONY project is rooted in the notion of internationalisation at home and strategic management of internationalisation in higher education. The HARMONY PROJECT, through its overall and specific activities and especially outputs on developing and implementing the Internationalisation strategies on Higher Education with main focus on Internationalisation at home issues at institutional levels in each Partner Country, India, Bangladesh and Viet Nam, is addressing the aims and objectives of the Capacity Building action, and particularly “Improving management and operation of Higher Education Institutions and Internationalisation of HEIs”.

Enabling Higher Education Institutions to strategically manage internationalisation in the provision of education, research, mobility, and services are regarded to be the project’s overall objective and the main underpinning of Partner countries’ accountable and complementary role in EU-Asia cooperation development.

question: What does International Projects-(SAP) - Vellore Institute of Technology say about EU Erasmus Project meeting and MOU signing event -12 April 2023?
answer_extract:
Vellore Institute of Technology(VIT) organized the European Union Erasmus+CBHE Harmony Project review meeting and conference during 12-13 April 2023 at VIT Vellore. VIT is part of the European Union Erasmus+CBHE Harmony Project on “Internationalization in Higher Education and Borderless Cooperation between European and Asian Universities” led by the University of Zaragoza, Spain. The Delegates from many Project partner institutions including Spain, Bulgaria, Slovenia, Lithuania, Moldova, Bangladesh, Vietnam, besides India attended the Conference.
The project led by Prof.Rafael de Miguel, Harmony Erasmus+ CBHE project coordinator of University of Zaragoza, Spain and Dr Olesea Sirbu, Founder and President of European Policy Development and Research Institute, Slovenia would support Internationalisation of higher education institutions in Asia and Europe including the curriculum design, virtual borderless mobility of students and faculty members, modernization of International Offices, and internationalization of teaching and learning process to facilitate international cooperation among European and Asian universities. Harmony Project also provides access to knowledge sharing practices in internationalization.

heading: EU Erasmus Project meeting and MOU signing event -12 April 2023

During the event, VIT Chancellor Dr G. Viswanathan signed the Memorandum of Understanding with six Universities from Europe and Asia for International academic cooperation programmes, Universities are: University of Zaragoza, Spain, European Policy Development and Research Institute, Slovenia, Academy of Economic Studies of Moldova, Varna University of Management, Varna, Bulgaria, Quang Binh University, Vietnam and University of Liberal Arts, Bangladesh.
Speaking on the occasion, Chancellor Dr.G.Viswanathan said that “VIT is proud to be a partner of these European and Asian institutions because it shared common subject areas in the state of the art technologies for research and development”. question: What does IQAC | VIT say about About?
answer_extract:
The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) was established in 2007 at Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT) as a post-accreditation quality sustenance measure.The IQAC has been constituted as per the recommendations of the National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC). The IQAC ensures the effective implementation of quality initiatives through continuous reviews and periodic meetings. The IQAC works towards attaining excellence in all academic and administrative endeavours of the institution.
Objectives
To develop a system for conscious, consistent and catalytic action to improve the academic and administrative performance of the institution. To promote measures for institutional functioning towards quality enhancement through internalization of quality culture and institutionalization of best practices
### Vision
To ensure quality culture as the prime concern for Vellore Institute of Technology through institutionalizing and internalizing all the initiatives taken with internal and external support.
### Quality Policy
To establish a system of Quality Enhancement, which would on a continuous basis evaluate and enhance the quality of teaching – learning, research and extension activities of the institution, leading to improvements in all processes, enabling the institution to attain excellence.
title: IQAC | VIT
heading: About

The extended learning facility for students at VIT was started in the year 2007. These learning help the students to get prepared for higher studies in India and abroad. question: What does International Sports and Cultural Fest | Annual technological and design Carnival | VIT say about RIVIERA?
answer_extract:
We at VIT believe that education isn’t confined to academic excellence, but extends to the overall development of a student. To facilitate this, VIT conducts various events and workshops.
Riviera, the annual International Sports and Cultural Fest, is one of the major events that gives our students a platform to showcase and shape their talent in various technical and managerial areas. Riviera has the honour of being the first University Cultural & Sports Event in India to be ISO 9001:2015 certified. The four day extravaganza is a celebration of dance, drama, debate, literature, art and culture. Our flagship events Aikya and Infusion add colour and richness to what we call “The Riviera Phenomenon”. Apart from these, there are events conducted by various clubs and associations which are also graced by celebrity guests from various walks of life. The Proshows on all four days witness leading playback singers and performers from the Indian music and film industry who perform at the big stage.

Apart from these celebrities, Indian Cricketer Murali Vijay, Music Director Ghibran, Actor Manchu Manoj, Actress Priya Anand, Radio Jockey-cum-Actor RJ Balaji and Nehal Chudasama and Miss India-Universe 2018 also graced us with their presence as Chief Guests for various events held during Riviera’19.

TEAM SAMMARD
Founded in 2017, Team Sammard is Vellore Institute of Technology's only rocketry team, focused on advancing student-led aerospace innovation. The team designs and builds sounding rockets, develops flight computers, and competes in global events like the International Rocket Engineering Competition (IREC-USA) and CanSat-USA.
Sammard has earned global recognition, ranking 7th in CanSat and 23rd in IREC, with past achievements including 1st in Asia-Pacific at CanSat 2018. The team specializes in rockets reaching 10,000 feet, CanSat satellites at 1,000 meters, and flight software like FLAIR for real-time data analysis. Notable projects include AGNEYA (2024), VAJRA (2023), and PINAKA (2022). By integrating CFD-based simulators and custom propulsion test benches, Sammard continues to push aerospace innovation forward.

TEAM ROVERX
Team RoverX, a student-led team from Creation Labs, VIT University, designs and builds Mars Rover prototypes for global competitions. Since its establishment in 2015, the team has advanced space robotics, excelling in mobility, autonomous navigation, and scientific exploration. Competing in events like the International Rover Challenge (IRC), University Rover Challenge (URC), and International Rover Design Challenge (IRDC), RoverX has earned a reputation as a top student-run rover team.

question: What does STARS-SUPPORT THE ADVANCEMENT OF RURAL STUDENTS | say about SUPPORT THE ADVANCEMENT OF RURAL STUDENTS - (STARS)?
answer_extract:
> A Child should never be deprived of quality education owing to poverty. This forceful thought in my mind became the seed that gave birth > to the innovative **STARS** Scheme > > – Dr.G.Viswanathan, Chancellor, > VIT- Vellore .
Philanthropy makes a big difference to people’s lives. On these lines, Our Beloved chancellor Dr.G.Viswanathan has taken several community development initiatives for the betterment of the society, and STARS (Support the Advancement of Rural Students Scheme) is one such philanthropic activity started in the year 2008. It aims at enhancing the rural students’ quality of life.
For children in rural villages of Tamil Nadu who grow up in difficult circumstances, VIT has become more than a place of academic instruction. It is a home away from home where they feel safe and happy, surrounded by caring Professors/Proctors who not only give them the education and skills to face the future, but also become their emotional pillar.

question: What does STARS-SUPPORT THE ADVANCEMENT OF RURAL STUDENTS | say about SUPPORT THE ADVANCEMENT OF RURAL STUDENTS - (STARS)?
answer_extract:

question: What does Placement Highlights | Career Development Centre say about Placement Highlights?
answer_extract:
The Career Development Centre (CDC) works towards creating an environment that encourages students to think beyond the classroom and to develop the necessary skills to excel in their chosen fields. The centre is committed to providing students with personalized career guidance, practical training, and relevant resources that can help them succeed in their careers.
1. To create a comprehensive platform that provides students with access to a wide range of career development resources. 2. To provide students with personalized career guidance that can help them identify their strengths, interests, and goals. 3. To organize talks, training sessions, and workshops that help students acquire the necessary skills and knowledge to excel in their chosen fields. 4. To provide continuing support to students throughout their academic journey and beyond, ensuring they are well-prepared for their careers. 5. To offer a soft skills curriculum that helps students develop interpersonal, communication, and leadership skills. 6. To facilitate industrial certifications and training that can help students stand out in the job market.

What is a Super Dream Offer at VIT?
VIT’s CDC classifies offers by CTC threshold into categories; Super Dream Offers are those above the higher published CTC threshold in a given cycle, representing the highest salary tier among all offers recorded. The specific CTC cut-off defining Super Dream is published by CDC each year.

The Solar Energy of India (SESI), established in 1978, having its Secretariat in New Delhi, is the Indian Section of the International Solar Energy Society (ISES). Its interests cover all aspects of renewable energy, including characteristics, effects and methods of use, and it provides a common ground to all those concerned with the nature and utilization of this renewable non-polluting resource.
The Society is interdisciplinary in nature, with most of the leading energy researchers and manufacturers of renewable energy systems and devices of the country as its members.
